news.text: Steady starter to an All-Star lock? Top-10 talent to an MVP? Breakout seasons take many forms in the NBA. Ben Golliver identifies 30 players primed to take the next step.

news.title: Which NBA father-son duos have the most points?
news.text: In 2024, Bronny James joined his father LeBron on the Los Angeles Lakers. Take a closer look at the highest-scoring father-son duos in NBA history.

news.title: Lakers' Luka Doncic scores NBA season-high 52 points with 10 assists in win
news.text: Luka Doncic scored 52 points, hitting eight 3-pointers, to lead the Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Jazz on Sunday. It was the first 50-point game this season in the NBA.

news.title: Luka Doncic scores NBA season-high 52 points in the Lakers' victory over the Jazz
news.text: — Luka Doncic scored 52 points, hitting eight 3-pointers, to lead the Los Angeles Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Utah Jazz on Sunday.

news.text: Los Angeles Lakers (2-0, first in the Western Conference) vs. Utah Jazz (1-1, eighth in the Western Conference)

news.title: Austin Reaves, Walker Kessler lead Lakers past Clippers 125-117 for 2nd win to start season
news.text: — Austin Reaves had 28 points and nine assists, Walker Kessler added 22 points and six blocked shots, and the Los Angeles Lakers beat the Los Angeles Clippers 125-117 on Friday night for their second win to start the season.

news.title: Ex-Laker Dalton Knecht joins Knicks on two-way contract
news.text: Former Lakers first-round pick Dalton Knecht has agreed to a two-way deal with the Knicks, his agents told ESPN's Shams Charania.

news.text: Which stars shined with their new teams? Which might want a do-over? Ben Golliver examines 12 opening week debuts.

news.title: Why Warriors-Lakers was the quiet end of an incredible NBA era
news.text: For more than a decade, LeBron James shaped a massive rivalry with Stephen Curry and the Warriors. Now he's gone. Left in his wake are two teams, each in dramatic transformation.

news.title: Luka Doncic embraces lead role, pairs with Kessler to dominate Warriors
news.text: For the Lakers, who have installed Luka Doncic as the heir to LeBron James and rebuilt their roster around him, the early results in a 127-105 win over the Warriors were a promising sign of things to come.

news.title: Warriors' Yaxel Lendeborg: 'Lost all respect' for Luka Doncic
news.text: Yaxel Lendeborg said it was an "interesting first game for me" after defending the Lakers superstar in his professional debut.

news.title: Walker Kessler has perfect Lakers debut with 12-for-12 shooting in 127-105 win over Warriors
news.text: — Walker Kessler scored 26 points on 12-for-12 shooting and grabbed nine rebounds during his auspicious debut for the Los Angeles Lakers in a 127-105 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Wednesday night.

news.title: Luka Dončić asks Lakers fans to support 'special team' in full-page ad
news.text: Lakers star Luka Dončić took out a full-page advertisement in the Los Angeles Times, addressing the city and saying "tonight we start our run for a championship."

news.title: The five biggest questions still facing Luka and the Lakers
news.text: After a transformative offseason on the floor and off, there are still massive unanswered questions for this Lakers team.

news.title: Warriors' Brandin Podziemski to miss opener vs. Lakers with back soreness
news.text: The Warriors will be without Brandin Podziemski for their season opener against the Lakers because of a back issue, a surprise scratch for the durable 23-year-old.

news.title: JJ Redick says Lakers' 'biggest unknown' is how they will deal with adversity
news.text: JJ Redick said the Lakers' "biggest unknown" is how his new-look roster sans LeBron James will deal with adversity.
